pr.t: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
pr.d: Ein Inselberg inmitten der Savanne entpuppt sich als genialer Rückzugsort für große und kleine Raubtiere. Mit Ausblick auf die Weiten der Serengeti ist der Granitfels heiß umkämpft. Vor allem Paviane und ein Löwenrudel konkurrieren um die Festung.

pr.t: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
pr.d: In der Savanne wütet ein verheerendes Feuer. Die Paviane suchen auf einem Inselberg Schutz und müssen doch vor dem Rauch fliehen. Die Löwen bleiben mit ihren Babys im Schutz des Felsens und können sich mit ihren Jungen in eine Höhle retten.

pr.t: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
pr.d: Das Land erholt sich nach dem Feuer, der Fluss führt Wasser. Während die Löwenjungen schutzlos den Gefahren der Savanne ausgesetzt sind, muss auch das Nilpferdbaby im Fluss das Überleben lernen. Sein Vater bleibt nach einem Kampf verwundet zurück.

pr.t: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
pr.d: Die Suche nach einem Zuhause bringt Tragödie und Triumph mit sich, denn das Nilpferdbaby Mafuta sieht sich neuen Gefahren gegenüber. Krokodil Magamba verteidigt ihre Jungtiere und Duma, der Gepard, kämpft darum, Freunde zu finden.

pr.t: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne
pr.d: Während das Land austrocknet, haben alle Schwierigkeiten, Wasser zu finden. Die Flusspferde geraten in den schrumpfenden See und Nalla, die Elefantin, findet eine clevere Lösung, um den Durst aller zu stillen.

pr.t: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne

Maya lebt mit ihren Mitte 30 Jahren in einer Wohngemeinschaft in München mit der temperamentvollen Sema. Ihr Ideal, einfach unbeschwert in der Gegenwart zu leben, wird plötzlich zur Herausforderung, denn das Messie-Problem ihrer Mutter holt sie ein und auch ihr Vater ist da keine Hilfe. Dazu wird die Balance zwischen ihren Jobs als Nagelpflegerin und freie Maskenbildnerin am Theater immer schwieriger zu wahren. Dann verliebt sie sich auch noch in den Tänzer Philip.

Nach dem Ersten Weltkrieg vertiefen sich die politischen Gräben in einem oberbayerischen Dorf. Der Schuster Julius Kraus, der zurückgezogen am Rande der Dorfgemeinschaft lebt, gerät immer tiefer in den Strudel der dramatischen politischen Ereignisse zwischen 1918 und der Machtergreifung Hitlers 1933. Als sein Freund und Nachbar, der Bauer Heingeiger, Bürgermeister wird, scheint Ruhe ins Dorf einzukehren, doch dem Sohn Heingeigers und begeistertem Hakenkreuzler ist der Schuster ein Dorn im Auge.

Zehn Jahre nach dem Machtaufstieg der Nazis herrschen im Dorf Misstrauen und Gewalt. SA-Sturmführer Silvan gerät in einen Strudel aus Rivalität, Erpressung und Schuld, als er im Streit den Erpresser seiner Familie erschlägt - beobachtet von Jungen.

Julia lebt mit unheilbarem, metastasiertem Brustkrebs. Trotz der drastisch verkürzten Lebenserwartung gelingt es der 30-Jährigen immer wieder, sich dem Leben zuzuwenden. Sie spricht über die Auseinandersetzung mit dem Tod.
pr.sub: Jung und todkrank - Wie Julia das Leben umarmt

pr.t: Die Tochter des Papstes - Lucrezia Borgia
pr.d: Die unglaubliche Geschichte der Papsttochter Lucrezia Borgia spielt in einer der skandalösesten Phasen der Renaissance. Unter der intriganten Herrschaft ihres Vaters, Papst Alexander VI., wird Lucrezia gezielt für politische Ziele benutzt.

Isabell arbeitet als Maklerin in Berlin und kümmert sich um ihre pflegebedürftigen Eltern im Wochenendhaus ihres Vaters. Ihre Ehe mit Philippe steht kurz vor dem Zerbrechen. In der brandenburgischen Provinz trifft sie Anja, eine alleinerziehende Mutter, die mit niedrigen Löhnen und Jobunsicherheit kämpft. Zwischen den Frauen entsteht eine zunehmend komplexe Verbindung. Diese Beziehung rüttelt an Isabells scheinbar stabilen Lebensentwürfen und offenbart emotionale Lücken und Sehnsüchte.

Charlie and Samy come across a body in the street. Everything suggests that it was a natural death, but Charlie's instinct pushes her to follow the trail of cat scratches which cover the corpse.

Gordon heads to Boston for the first of two visits to La Galleria 33, an Italian restaurant opened in 2006 by raucous sisters Rita and Lisa. The two siblings grew up working at their father's successful restaurant nearby, but when they opened their own establishment, the customers didn't materialise. The sisters blame everything from the weather to the tablecloths for their failures.

In east Kent, outspoken estate agent Sean and his girlfriend Beth kick off the competition with a Welsh-themed menu. Day two sees Marcus and Miguel lay on a Malaysian feast, but Sean's teasing of his girlfriend steals the limelight.

pr.t: Hitler's DNA: Blueprint of a Dictator
pr.d: The team make an astonishing discovery: a genetic mutation that causes a medical condition called Kallmann Syndrome, which disrupts the development of sex organs. Geneticist Turi King investigates the syndrome.

In China, an obesity crisis and the cultural pressure to be thin are pushing young people towards extreme ways to lose weight. Ciaran Jenkins travels to Chengdu to explore China's often contradictory food and body culture.

Presenters Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer mix a cookery show with a chat show, and the result is `Sunday Brunch.' Each installment finds Simon and Tim cooking in the kitchen, accompanied by that week's celebrity guests. Other segments include interviews and highlights from television and film, an expert who assists with drink tasting, a round-up of what is trendy, and the ever-popular `Sunday Brunch Playlist,' which consists of music videos chosen by the presenters and their guests. Guests have included Stacey Solomon, Lisa Faulkner, Tara Reid, Rufus Wainwright and Marina Diamandis.

Tony snaps at Dee Dee, who continues to act up, and alarm bells ring when Sienna realises that Dee Dee spent the night at Abigail's. Jack and Pearl plan their big day. And there's a tense showdown between Imran and Ste.

Rebecca throws a birthday party for the son of her boss. When Woody, whom she hires as a clown at Frasier's suggestion, has to substitute as Mark Antony in a play for an actor who is ill, a reluctant Frasier is pressured into substituting for Woody.
The day of the annual Boston Bloody Mary Competition dawns and Sam and the Cheers gang are determined to beat Gary's Old Town Tavern. Woody feels inadequate and goes to work for another bar.

Bluey und Bingo sind genervt davon, immer zu hören, was sie zu tun haben. Somit beauftragen sie ihre riesige, unsichtbare Freundin damit, ihren Eltern zu zeigen, wer der Boss ist. Jetzt können sie tun und lassen, was sie wollen, bis sie rebellieren.

Bluey und Bingo malen beim Faceytalk mit Muffin und Socks viel zu gern schöne Sachen aufs Videobild. Dabei müssen sie sich aber an die Regel halten, dass sie nicht alles auf einmal an sich reißen, sondern sich abwechseln müssen.

Wenn es Bluey und Bingo gelingt, Dad zum Auto zu bringen, fahren sie gemeinsam zur Eisdiele. Allerdings stehen sie vor der Herausforderung, dass Dad derzeit im Modus "Fauler Sack" ist und die Eiscreme womöglich auf sich warten lassen muss.

Der Vater erzählt Bluey und Bingo ein echtes Märchen über das Aufwachsen an einem wilden Ort in den 80er Jahren. Danach gibt es noch eine Geschichte über einen Jungen, der verflucht wurde, als er gemein zu seinem kleinen Bruder war.
Mum beschließt, dass Bluey gemeinsam mit ihrer Familie musikalische Statuen spielen sollen.

Nach erstem Schock nimmt Joe den ungebetenen Gast, der sich als seine Tochter herausstellt, notgedrungen mit ins Trainingslager und später zur Eröffnung seines neuen Nachtclubs. Zuerst nur für eine gute Presse versucht er den liebenden Daddy zu geben.

J.D.s neue Freundin Kylie kommt ihn bei der Arbeit besuchen und er will sie beeindrucken. Das verleitet ihn, zu erwähnen, dass ein Patient, der vor kurzem in Hongkong war, SARS haben könnte. Das führt dazu, dass die gesamte Klinik in Quarantäne muss.

Der Autor von J.D.s Lieblingssitcom wird ins Sacred Heart eingeliefert. Leider findet J.D. heraus, dass der Mann an Lungenkrebs leidet. J.D. flüchtet sich in einen Tagtraum, in dem der Alltag eine alberne Sitcom ist und alle ihr Happy End finden.

J.D.s Freundin Kylie hat ihn noch immer nicht bei sich einziehen lassen. Carla und Turk haben ihn vor die Tür gesetzt und nun wandert er einsam durch die Nacht. Inzwischen wird Dr. Cox von seinem alten Highschool-Freund Ron besucht.

Molly schaut für einen kurzen Besuch im Sacred Heart vorbei. Vor allem J.D. freut sich riesig über diese Überraschung. Denn da Kylie ihn noch immer nicht ans "Eingemachte" lässt, verfällt er der Idee, Molly zu verführen.

Carla sucht bei Elliot Unterschlupf, während J.D. und Turk auf Kneipentour gehen. Elliot versucht Carla aufzuheitern, aber es gelingt ihr nicht so recht. Cox überredet Dr. Kelso, sich auch mal selbst wieder um einen Patienten zu kümmern.
Als Donald und Micky herausfinden, dass Goofys Wunschreiseziel Kartoffelland gar nicht existiert, versuchen sie gemeinsam diesen Vergnügungspark seiner Träume für ihn zu bauen.

A prison guard apparently witnesses a terrifying encounter between an inmate and her dead brother. Documentary drama telling the stories of paranormal encounters.
pr.sub: He Made Me Do It; New York Nights; The Passenger

pr.d: Cam and David both have a unique relationship with the land, and soon realise that ghosts share this affinity.
A man experiences a ghost at a London theatre before a scream alerts hundreds of people to its presence; ghosts of people who died in a hotel fire.
A woman sees the ghost of a young boy watching over her newborn at the hospital, and a young girl is haunted by ghostly men in the closet of a Boston school that was formerly an infirmary.
Sophie lives in a Detroit mansion with a pleasant ghost, but things take a frightening turn when Sophie's father finds the key to a room where a dead body was once stashed.
After an experience with a ghost, a man gains courage and becomes a better dancer; a man learns to live with a ghost who inspires him to write song lyrics.
In our world the elderly are often a source of experience and wisdom, but in the supernatural world ghosts of the aged can be terrifying and dangerous.
Discovering why trauma binds the dead to the living, a nurse believes cold spots and odd noises are coming from a patient's stuck spirit, and a ghost cannot exit a hospital café.

Strange things go bump in the night when a youth worker has a hair-raising encounter at an overnight treatment centre, a ghostly gang roams hospital halls, and a counsellor ends up being banished by a surly spirit.

A look at how psychic energy gathers at the scene of life-or-death crises, a psychiatric hospital with a reputation for being haunted, and a nurse who describes the spirits she sees walking her hospital's halls.

Return to Jailer's Inn, where the team's first investigation finds a moving ball of environmental changes that registered on multiple metres. See if they can replicate their results as they investigate reports of voices and footsteps from upstairs.

The hunt is on for the ghost brother of Diamond Point's building director, who still feels his presence in the city welcome centre. Investigators explore apparitions, voices, and phantom smells that keep popping up in the former family home.

Revisit Karric-Parks' House, where the team is keen to determine if the cavern behind the home is its source of supernatural power. Watch as they team up with local investigators to replicate the finds from their first visit.
Probe the eerie Civil War apparitions inside a Confederate general's home.

Lauren discovers that the guardian angel phenomenon she experienced as a child may now be protecting her son. This revelation leads her to consider that the ability to witness paranormal activity and see deceased loved ones might be genetic.

After a restless night of intermittent sleep, Gregg and Justin discover they shared an identical dream. In this vivid vision, they were visited by their ancestors in a heartwarming, joint family gathering, replete with specific details.

Ashley recounts the story of her beloved sister-in-law's tragic death. Investigating the strange paranormal experience that convinced her that their sisterly bond was not something that death could ever break.
Kennedy has a close relationship with her great-grandmother, which persists well after her death. They stay in touch and Kennedy also has other encounters with dear, departed ancestors.
Stepping into a home with an evil past, where spirits put a father in the hospital.
Get chills when a couple's secret phrase unites them from beyond the grave.

Ghosts linger in small-town America, and the locations of former battlegrounds are ripe for paranormal experiences. The American Civil War, the deadliest conflict in US history, has given rise to many haunted battlegrounds.
In the paranormal realm, entities manifest and terrify in many ways, often demanding attention with their poltergeist activity which includes the bumps and noises that haunt people at night.

Throughout time, humans have honoured their dead in unique ways. The one thing they all have in common is the final resting place is spiritually sacred. So when the activities of the living lead to disturbing the dead, the results can be terrifying.

Around the globe, seemingly perfect towns and cities conceal tortured spirits within their walls. These souls are distorted by the trauma, with suffering and anguish inflicted upon them in life and death.

In the run-up to September 1939, political and economic chaos in the aftermath of World War I allowed Hitler in Germany, Mussolini in Italy and ultranationalists in imperial Japan to seize absolute power.

Germany took just four weeks to conquer Poland, using a new form of warfare, Blitzkrieg. Six armoured tank units known as Panzer divisions, supported by the Luftwaffe, quickly broke through Polish defences.

After the retreat from Dunkirk, Churchill rallied Britain in its darkest hour. Hitler was only just across the channel, but he reckoned without our supreme strategist, the might of the navy and the manoeuvrability of the air force.
Explores Hitler's assault on the Soviet Union in the summer of 1941.
The attack on Pearl Harbour brought the country nicknamed the 'sleeping giant', aka America, into the war, and saw the emergence of the aircraft carrier as the pre-eminent weapon of the seas.

Italian dictator Benito Mussolini dreamed of recreating the Roman Empire and making the Mediterranean the centre of a new vast colonial empire, including British-controlled Egypt and Sudan to the south.

With their armies fully engaged on the battlegrounds, the Allied and Axis powers focused their efforts to develop new weapons and new strategies to deliver a knockout blow to the enemy and bring about a quick end to the conflict.
After Hitler's gamble in the East fails, the Soviet Union starts to slowly push back and grow.

By early 1944, Hitler had long been expecting an Allied attack on north-western France, but his problem was knowing when and where it would come. This episode has a look at the Allied operations Bodyguard and Overlord.
Concentrates on Hitler's attempts to shift the balance of power back in his favour.
The war in the Pacific against Japan was a savage hand-to-hand, island-to-island struggle, fought by new specialist fighting units like the valiant Chindits.
Allied forces converge on Germany, uncovering the horrors of Belsen and Buchenwald, before pushing towards Berlin, where Adolf Hitler is clinging to power in his last desperate days.

pr.d: In 1945, Allied bombings devastated Germany. James Holland joins Dan Snow to discuss its impact on WWII.

pr.d: The US Navy trained nearly 15,000 pilots on Lake Michigan from 1942-1945, resulting in the sinking of more than 100 classic World War II fighters and dive bombers.

pr.t: Swordfish: World War II's Surprising Aircraft And The Raid That Changed History
pr.d: Fairey Swordfish was a tough WWII biplane, famed for torpedo attacks despite outdated design.

pr.t: Aircraft Carrier: Guardian Of The Seas

The documentary details the Bismarck's search and sinking, featuring naval historians and Angus Konstam.

After the devastating loss of HMS Hood, the Royal Navy became focused on one objective, sinking the Bismarck. The flagship of the German Kriegsmarine had not survived completely unscathed from the exchange with the Hood and HMS Prince of Wales.

pr.t: The Air War: The Escalation of Allied Bombing
pr.d: The filmmaker sheds light on the controversial bombing campaigns that were unleashed during World War II and explores whether they actually achieved their intended outcomes.

Join Andy McGrath on a captivating journey into British Ufology, uncovering notorious cases across the country. He explores the Welsh Triangle, meets childhood eyewitnesses recounting UFO and Men in Black encounters, and revisits UFO landing sites.

Andy embarks on an enchanting journey to a haunted bookshop once graced by Charles Dickens, investigates the captivating mystery of King John's missing bones, and delves into the intriguing rumours of Oliver Cromwell's deal with the devil.

In medieval England, the North was ruled from York. Dan Jones explores the history of its castle, from the Viking Jorvik and the Normans, through the dark days of the anti-Jewish pogrom and the imprisonment of the Knights Templar, to one of its most colourful inmates - the legendary highwayman Dick Turpin.

With the aid of dramatic reconstruction, Dan Jones explores the 900-year history of the beautiful Leeds Castle in Kent, from its origins as a royal Saxon family's manor and Norman stronghold to the private property of six medieval queens, a Tudor palace, a Jacobean country house, a Georgian mansion and an elegant 20th-century retreat for the rich and famous.
Alice enjoys a Roman feast in Britain's most Roman city, Chester. She examines a radical theory on the Romans' plans for the city and explores an incredible archaeological find deep underground.
In York, Professor Alice Roberts takes part in a Viking battle, meets the metal detectorists behind one of the UK's greatest archaeological finds, and gets her hands on Viking poo.
Andy is back in Cornwall searching for legends, meeting a real-life mermaid and fishing for Cornwall's infamous sea serpent Morgawr.
In Belfast, the UK's most Victorian city, Alice Roberts visits the shipyards that built the Titanic, gets locked up in the Crumlin Road gaol and learns about 19th-century etiquette.

Professor Alice Roberts explores the most exciting recent archaeological finds in the east of Britain. A team unearths a mass grave, divers search the Thames for clues to a 17th-century tragedy, and a metal detectorist makes the find of a lifetime.
A team discovers clues to Scotland's first kingdoms, metal detectorists unearth a hoard of Viking treasure, and a new housing development reveals a graveyard of Iron Age warriors.
On its 200th anniversary, a team of experts uncovers the hidden mysteries of the Battle of Waterloo. It marked the final defeat of Napoleon and was one of the bloodiest battles ever fought.
The story of Cleopatra Selene, the little-known daughter of Cleopatra and Mark Antony, who witnessed her dynasty collapse amidst her parents' defeat and suicide but survived to become a great queen.

Professor Alice Roberts explores British history through the stories of individual towns. Alice examines Britain in wartime by looking at the coastal town of Dover, a town that found itself on the frontline in the struggle against Nazi Germany.
Professor Alice Roberts explores the Georgian era in her hometown of Bristol, from architectural gems to the world's first chocolate factory, backstreet gin and the horror of the slave trade.
Andy searches for dragons in Somerset, visits the grave of Arthur and Guinevere and tests the healing waters of a spring once used to wash the Holy Grail.

In search of adventure, Andy dives into Britain's weirdest events. He chases cheese down a hill in Gloucestershire, bog dives in Wales, eats chillies in Dorset, navigates a homemade raft in Monmouth, and faces Vikings at Tintagel.
We join a team as they undertake the largest maritime investigation since the Mary Rose and reveal the extraordinary story of HMS Invincible.

Professor Alice Roberts explores 2018's best archaeological finds from the east of the UK: a monument as old as Stonehenge, a dig at the site of Britain's first tank battle, and some disturbing Roman burials.

Dan is in the heart of the English countryside at Warwick Castle. While it appears idyllic today, for centuries it was a poisoned chalice to the Earls of Warwick who lived there and its walls echo with tales of betrayal, bloodshed and murder.

Archaeologists continue their exploration of Pompeii, uncovering the secrets of this fascinating ancient city, with surprises to be found and trouble ahead.

Die Kalamas übernehmen ein renovierungsbedürftiges Haus in Manoa und glauben zunächst an einen vielversprechenden Fund. Doch beim Abriss kommen massive Probleme mit den Leitungen, Termitenschäden und eine kostspielige Überraschung zum Vorschein.

Kamohai und Tristyn besichtigen auf O'ahu ein stark verfallenes und vermülltes Haus, das seit 20 Jahren leer steht. Kamohai sieht das Potenzial, es nach der Renovierung für stolze 1,4 Millionen Dollar zu verkaufen und beginnt den Umbau.
Ein verheiratetes Surferpaar sucht in Virginia Beach nach einem bezahlbaren Strandhaus, das zu seinem Lebensstil passt.

Nach der Geburt ihres Kindes möchte ein Paar den eisigen Wintern in Michigan entkommen und sich in Fort Myers Beach in Florida niederlassen. Gesucht wird ein bezahlbares Strandhaus für das neue Familienleben unter Palmen.

Ein junges Paar wünscht sich ein neues Traumhaus mit tollem Ausblick auf Maui. Ihm ist dabei besonders wichtig, dass es einen Garten gibt, der sich zum Obst- und Gemüseanbau eignet. Das Budget liegt bei etwa 1,2 Millionen Dollar.

Susie und Marty träumen bereits seit ihren Flitterwochen davon, aus Seattle wegzuziehen und sich ein neues Leben auf Hawaii aufzubauen. Ihr neues Zuhause soll unbedingt Meerblick, Gästezimmer und einen Pool haben. Das Paar will viel surfen.

Laura kehrt nach 40 Jahren auf dem Festland zurück in ihre Heimat auf Maui. Gemeinsam mit ihrer Schwester sucht sie das perfekte Haus in Strandnähe mit altem Hawaii-Charme. Ihr großzügiges Budget bietet viele Möglichkeiten.

Mike und Masha tauchen für ihr Leben gern. Nun kehren sie nach 25 Jahren nach Hawaii zurück, um sich dort für immer niederzulassen. Auf "Big Island" sucht das sportbegeisterte Paar nach einem Haus am Wasser und mit Garten.

Die Musiker Rob und Anitra treten in Houston und im ganzen Land auf und wollen mit einem Tiny House auf Tour gehen. Um Geld zu sparen, wollen sie ihr neues Zuhause selbst bauen, doch zuerst müssen sie es schaffen, ihre Geschmäcker zu vereinen.

Bill und Jamie ziehen zurück in ihren Heimatstaat Michigan. Sie suchen ein Tiny House mit Seeblick, doch mit zwei Kindern wird die Suche nach einem winzigen, mobilen und überschaubaren Haus eine große und unerwartete Herausforderung.

Nancy hat die kalten Winter in Chicago satt. Deshalb sucht sie ein pflegeleichtes Tiny House in Orlando, Florida, wo sie mehr Zeit in der Natur mit ihrem Hund verbringen kann. Außerdem hofft sie dadurch Geld sparen zu können und ohne Kälte zu leben.

Die baldige Studentin Sarah sucht in Charleston, South Carolina nach einem Tiny Haus. Ihr Plan ist nämlich, dadurch mietfrei leben zu können, um neben ihrem Studiendarlehen unnötige Schulden vermeiden zu können, dabei aber komplett mobil zu sein.

Liz und Tyler planen völlig neue Wege zu gehen und wollen daher nach Spanien auswandern. Dort soll Liz weiter an ihrer Karriere als Reisejournalistin feilen. Tyler hat eine Büroanstellung. Er möchte seinen Arbeitsweg verkürzen.

In diesem Format ziehen Menschen in weit entfernte Länder. Sie wollen einen Neuanfang. Dies erfordert meist Mut und Durchhaltevermögen, da das Auswandern stets mit Herausforderungen verbunden ist. Der Zuschauer erhält authentische Einblicke.

Die Tochter von Tina ist erwachsen, weswegen sie sich den Traum vom Umzug ins Ausland ermöglicht. In Okinawa, Japan, wird sie nun als Sozialarbeiterin tätig sein. Ihre Tochter sucht eine moderne Wohnung nach ihren Vorstellungen.

Stephanie zieht samt ihrer Familie nach Ho-Chi-Minh, wo sie eine neue Position bekleidet. Aktuell fehlt die passende Bleibe. Paul möchte typisch vietnamesisch wohnen. Stephanie will lieber modern und in einer ruhigen Lage leben.

Die Schwestern Julie und Nikki möchten von nun an gemeinsam wohnen und suchen eine Bleibe. Diese soll in Phnom Penh in Kambodscha situiert sein. Das Zusammenleben soll zukünftig anders ablaufen, als in ihrer vergangenen Kindheit.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Debbie aus Sacramento in Kalifornien hat sechs Dollar zum Lottospiel eingesetzt und damit den Jackpot von 1,6 Millionen US-Dollar gewonnen. Da sie mit ihrer Familie am Wohnort schon ein Haus besitzt, soll nun ein Ferienhaus in Mexiko erworben werden.
Eine Frau zieht mit ihrem Hund und ihrer besten Freundin nach Nashville und sucht dort ein Zuhause.

Eine Superplanerin, die bei ihrer besten Freundin untergekommen ist, weiß, dass es an der Zeit ist, sich eine eigene Wohnung in Nashville zu suchen, aber die Liste der Zusatzleistungen für eine ehrgeizige Renovierung häuft sich immer weiter.

Eine Familie einschließlich Großmutter möchte sich ein Haus in der Gemeinde Anna Maria Island in Florida kaufen. Obwohl das Budget klein ist, träumen sie von mehreren Zimmern und einem Pool. Nun suchen sie nach einem renovierungsbedürftigen Haus.

Ein Ehepaar sucht mithilfe einer guten Freundin, die als Maklerin arbeitet, ein wunderschönes Altbau-Strandhaus in Virginia. Die Maklerin findet ein renovierungsbedürftiges Traumhaus am Wasser, das dem Paar gefallen könnte.

Der ruhige Ort Westport in Washington ist eine Perle am Pazifik. Amy und Randy hoffen auf ein Wochenenddomizil am Strand für 175.000 Dollar inklusive Renovierung, um schöne Stunden mit ihren Kindern verbringen zu können.

Nachdem sie in ihrem jetzigen Haus einen Mäusebefall festgestellt hatten, entkernten sie es und holten Tamara und ihr Team ins Haus, um ihr Mäusehaus in eine Oase ohne Tiere zu verwandeln. Tamara und ihr Team setzen dabei alle Kräfte ein.

Tamara bekommt Hilfe von ihrem Vater Ward, den Kindern und Cousins, während sie unermüdlich daran arbeitet, das Haus ihrer Schwester zu renovieren. Dabei unterstützen sie die anderen auf ihre ganz eigene Weise bei dem Umbau.

Tamara und ihr Team verwandeln einen völlig entkernten Rohbau eines Anwesens in ein Traumhaus im europäischen Stil. Dadurch erhoffen sie sich, mögliche Interessenten anzulocken, die den Stil eines Chateaus zu schätzen wissen.
Kashmiras "Unordnung hinter verschlossenen Türen" verstopft das Haus der Familie.

Jaime liebt es, ihre Freunde in ihrer Ein-Zimmer-Wohnung im Stadtzentrum zu empfangen. Das Problem ist, dass das Zimmer vollgestopft ist mit Handtaschen, Kleidung und Schuhen, die Jaime im Laufe der Jahre angesammelt hat.
Als alleinerziehende Mutter von vier Söhnen hat eine Frau lange drei Jobs gleichzeitig gestemmt. Dann gewinnt sie mit einem Rubbellos fünf Millionen Dollar und ihr Leben verändert sich schlagartig.
Nach einer Erbschaft möchte ein Paar in ein Feriendomizil investieren, das an die verstorbene Mutter, den Vater und den Bruder der Frau erinnert.

Mit einem Gewinn von 100.000 Dollar ist eine Frau aus Sarasota endlich bereit, ihre Mietwohnung hinter sich zu lassen und ein eigenes Zuhause zu kaufen. Sie wünscht sich viel Platz und eine Lage in der Nähe der weißen Sandstrände Floridas.
Nach ihrem Umzug von Long Island nach North Carolina müssen sich ein Paar und seine gemeinsamen Zukunftspläne einigen unerwarteten Rückschlägen stellen.

Nach einem Gewinn von 250.000 Dollar hat ein Mann seiner Familie bereits ihr Traumhaus gekauft. Dann schlägt das Glück erneut zu und ein weiterer Gewinn von einer Million Dollar eröffnet ganz neue Möglichkeiten.
Nach dem Verkauf ihres Ferienhauses in Georgia ist ein Paar bereit für den nächsten Schritt. In San Diego suchen die beiden nach einem luxuriösen neuen Sommerdomizil.

Ein Paar hat in einer Lotterie den großen Coup gelandet und plant seinen Ruhestand. Das neue Zuhause soll an der Küste von Pamlico Sound in North Carolina liegen. David Bromstad soll dort eine geeignete Luxusimmobilie finden.

John und Laura gewinnen kurz nach ihrer Verlobung eine Million US-Dollar in der Lotterie. Aus diesem Grund wollen sie sich eine neue Bleibe kaufen. Diese soll historischen Charme haben. Der Immobilienfachmann David Bromstad soll unterstützen.

Michael gewinnt 100.000 Dollar und nur fünf Wochen später weitere 750.000 Dollar. Zuerst kauft Michael seiner Tochter und ihrer Familie ein Haus in North Carolina. Anschließend sucht er nach einem Stadthaus für sich in der Nähe seiner Tochter.

Für einen professionellen Pokerprofi soll David Bromstad ein riesiges Familienanwesen entlang der Main Line von Philadelphia finden. Die Immobilie soll modern und einzigartig sein. Der Kunde hat extrem hohe Ansprüche an die Ästhetik.
A flat in Sutton in London, a studio apartment in Chatham in Kent and a terraced house in Middlesbrough are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners.

A bungalow in Biggin Hill with huge potential, a centuries-old cottage in a beautiful part of Devon and an end terrace crying out for an upstairs bathroom are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and hear their plans.

Martel Maxwell joins the team, and looks at an old mews house in an historic part of Litchfield in Staffordshire, while Martin Roberts assesses the potential of a bungalow in Hanley in Stoke-on-Trent.

Martel Maxwell looks at a large terraced house in Dover in Kent with bags of potential, Martin Roberts is in Camborne in Cornwall viewing a house with lots of issues, and Dion Dublin meets a couple who bought a flat in Woodford Green in Essex.

Martel Maxwell is in Gillingham in Kent meeting a couple embarking on their first renovation development, Martin Roberts talks to a man with ambitious plans for a house in London's Chingford, and Dion Dublin looks round a semi in Wolverhampton.

Martel Maxwell hears development plans for a two-bedroom flat in Godalming in Surrey, Martin Roberts looks at a house in a terrible state of repair in Telford in Shropshire, and Dion Dublin sizes up the work needing to be done at a terraced house in Smethwick in the West Midlands.
A flat with great sea views in Margate in Kent, a bungalow in Whaley Thorns in Nottinghamshire and an end terrace in Longbridge in Birmingham are all sold under the hammer.

A terraced house in Derby, a bungalow in Penrhiwceiber in the Welsh valleys and a commercial property ripe for conversion in Silverdale near Newcastle-under-Lyme are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Dion and Martel meet the new owners.

A large semi in New Barnet in London is bought as an ambitious project to turn into a family home, a family do up a semi in Dover in Kent to make a profit, and two friends club together to try their hand at refurbishing a terraced house in Derby.

A large Victorian semi packed full of original features in Dresden in Stoke-on-Trent, a two-bed semi in Croydon in London and some public loos in Kincardine in Fife are sold at auction. Martin, Dion and Martel meet the new owners and hear their plans for their auction buys.
A huge 1930s house in Kidderminster, Worcestershire, a purpose-built flat in a 1980s block in Wembley, North London, and a substantial Victorian semi in Burslem, Staffordshire, are sold at auction.

A house in need of a total refurbishment in London's St John's Wood sells for well over a million pounds while a terrace in Birkenhead near Liverpool and a piece of land in Handsworth in Birmingham sell for much more modest sums. But all three projects require a lot of hard work from their new owners to make the best of their auction buys.

A mid-terrace house with period features in Forest Gate in London, a house with a stream but close to a railway line in Handsacre in Staffordshire, and a large three-storey property in Plymouth are all sold at auction.
A third-floor flat in Walworth in London, a piece of land in Derbyshire's Chesterfield, and a block of flats in Hengoed in Mid-Glamorgan are all sold under the hammer.

Martel Maxwell visits a house in Guildford, Martin Roberts falls in love with a Grade II-listed house in Torquay in Devon, and Dion Dublin is in Barry in Wales assessing all the work needed on a mid-terrace house. Will the developers' plans run smoothly?

Martel talks to a 20-year-old developer whose fourth property is in Madeley Heath, Dion meets two friends refurbishing a flat in Birkenhead, and Martin talks to identical twin brothers who have ambitious plans for a derelict fire station in Paisley.

A bungalow in Callington in Cornwall, a three-bed semi in Willenhall near Wolverhampton and a terraced house in Hertfordshire's Watford are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Dion and Martel meet the new owners, and hear their plans for their auction buys.

Lucy Alexander talks to experienced developers who deliver a stunning renovation on a subsidence-troubled semi in Coulsdon in Surrey, Dion Dublin meets two brothers with ambitious plans for a commercial property in Derby, and Martel Maxwell meets with two golfing friends turned developers who plan to turn round a one-bedroom flat in Telford in Shropshire in record time.

A two-bed detached house ripe for extending in Bilston near Wolverhampton, a cosy cottage in Nettlestead Green in Kent and a terraced house in Etruria in Stoke-on-Trent without a bathroom or an inside loo are all sold under the hammer.

A garage with development potential in Margate in Kent, a ground-floor flat in a Victorian house in Shepherd's Bush, London, and a piece of land ripe for building on in Birmingham are all sold under the hammer.

Featuring a couple of terraces in Caerphilly in Wales and Bootle on Merseyside, as well as an ambitious project to develop a large former mill in Stoke-on-Trent. Martin, Dion and Martel talk to the new owners and follow progress on the developments which could take anything from a few months to several years to complete.

Two terraces near beautiful countryside in Prestatyn in North Wales and Darley Dale in the Peak District and a shop and flat in Folkestone in Kent are all sold under the hammer. All three properties need a lot of work and Martin, Dion and Lucy meet the new investors to hear their plans.

On January 2, 2005, Edna Rivers, a night nurse at a nursing home, fails to show up for her shift. This raises the alarm with her employers, who know her as a reliable employee who would even call if she was going to be a little late.

Discover the horrific details of the murder of 20-year-old Ethan Bosworth, whose life was brutally ended by 17-year-old Cameron Kim. A story of jealousy, anger and the tragic consequences of uncontrollable obsession.

pr.sub: Anna Bui, Jordan Ebner and Jake Long

pr.sub: My Pregnant Daughter was Strangled to Death by Her Boyfriend

Brian and Carla Burns were going through a messy divorce when she disappeared, and Brian's explanation almost defied belief.
Mahmuda Khatun had managed to escape one unhappy arranged marriage before she made a drastic plan to end the second.
Denise Williams was devastated when her husband Mike disappeared on a hunting trip. He was feared drowned or eaten by alligators, but his mother didn't buy it.

Paramedic Paul Novak kills his wife Catherine, then sets fire to the house in a bid to make it look like an accidental death.

Malcolm Webster's wife was killed in a tragic car accident, but when his second wife has a brush with death, questions around Webster begin to circulate.
Kelly and George Worgan were the picture of wedded bliss. But they were hiding debt, despair and a controlling marriage.
To others, Stephen Searle was a politician, veteran and pub landlord. To his wife Anne, he was a violent abuser. Only her death would expose his true nature.
George Young gave his friend Tim Lee a job and a place to stay. But Tim and George's wife Tia repaid him with betrayal.
Tiffany Hill tried everything to keep her abusive husband Keland away from her, but even the law couldn't stop a man hell-bent on violence.
A look at Raoul Moat's shooting spree in Northumberland during the summer of 2010, and the huge manhunt that led to his arrest and the aftermath of his vicious attacks.
In an emotional tribute, witnesses and victims' relatives look back on the tragic murder of 16 children and a teacher at Dunblane Primary School in 1996.
A newly divorced young woman goes missing, and the case goes cold. Decades later, a determined FBI agent manages to break a chilling family pact wide open.
Eighteen-year-old Rose Larner from Lansing, Michigan, disappears without a trace. One of the largest manhunts in the history of the state remains unsuccessful, but Rose's mother does not give up.

Atlanta-area detectives find the decomposing body of college student Carlnell Walker in the boot of his car. They suspect the motive is somehow connected to his pumped-up social media profile and larger-than-life rap persona.
In Alabama, a trucker discovers the body of 19-year-old college student Shea Graham on the side of the road. Shea was supposed to testify in court the next day.
Over 25 years after a young man's body is found in the woods, detectives are shocked when a proclaimed killer appears live on the local news.
A storm in Key Largo, Florida allows an intruder to break into a newlywed couple's house. When the storm clears, the community is shocked to discover a double murder.
When a mother and daughter are found brutally murdered at home in quiet Woburn, Massachusetts, investigators leave no stone unturned to find the double murderer.
When Jamie Fraley vanishes from her flat, detectives suspect her boyfriend's obsessive father is involved. However, a grim discovery changes the course of the investigation.

Im Jahr 1989 kam es bei einem United-Airlines-Flug zu einer Triebwerksexplosion. Mit nur zwei von drei Triebwerken und ohne intaktes Steuerungssystem gelang es den Piloten die Maschine notzulanden - und 184 Leben zu retten. Eine Leistung, die vor allem einem Passagier zu verdanken war: ein Testpilot, der im Flugsimulator lernte, eine Maschine ausschließlich unter Nutzung der Triebwerke zu landen.

Diese Folge befasst sich mit einer Region des Nahen Ostens, die von Ruinen übersät ist. Außerdem wird in Taiwan ein seltsames Bauwerk erforscht, das die Herzen derjenigen, die seinen wahren Zweck kannten, in Angst und Schrecken versetzte.

Diese Folge wirft einen Blick auf einige unheimliche Ruinen, die in den bewaldeten Hügeln von Arkansas versteckt sind. Außerdem gibt es einen Blick auf ein heruntergekommenes Arbeitslager in Albanien, in dem Staatsfeinde untergebracht waren.

Diese Folge der Sendung wirft einen Blick auf eine Vulkaninsel vor der Küste Taiwans mit gruseligen Ruinen aus einer dunklen Ära. Außerdem wird eine Miniatureisenbahn, die in den Wäldern von Arkansas versteckt ist, erforscht.

Diese Folge der Sendung wirft einen Blick auf das Hartwood Hospital in Lanarkshire, Schottland. Das Gebäude war einst eines der größten psychiatrischen Krankenhäuser in Europa. Experten diskutieren über die dunkle Geschichte des imposanten Gebäudes.

Die Dokumentation zeigt die im Wald gelegenen höhlenartigen Kuppelbauten in Indien, die seit ihrer Darstellung durch die Beatles als "Ashram" berühmt geworden sind. Die heute bröckelnden Bauten waren einst der Gipfel des spirituellen Luxus.

Die Beamten am Flughafen Newark Liberty International stoppen einen Dominikaner, der eine große Menge an Baby-Kampffischen in die USA einführen will. Außerdem versucht ein US-Bürger, verbotene kubanische Zigarren ins Land zu bringen.

Am Flughafen von San Francisco wird ein Mann verhaftet, der kiloweise Cannabis schmuggeln wollte, wo Marihuana, anders als in Kalifornien, illegal ist. In Detroit filzen US-Zoll- und Grenzbeamte in einer 100-Prozent Kontrolle ein Flugzeug aus Mexiko.

pr.sub: Luna 2.0 - Die neue Lust am Mond

pr.d: Die Wissenschaft weiß mittlerweile viel über das Sonnensystem. Aber noch steckt die stellare Nachbarschaft voller Rätsel. So gibt es am äußersten Rand des Sonnensystems einige unbekannte Himmelskörper, die seltsame Umlaufbahnen beschreiben.
pr.sub: Mythos Planet Neun - Die Suche nach einem Phantom

pr.d: Diese Folge "Spacetime" zeigt, warum unser Planetensystem etwas ganz Besonderes ist, und erforscht die Frage, ob Menschen doch nur das Ergebnis eines kosmischen Zufalls sind. Forschende wissen, dass Sternsysteme anfangs immer gleich entstehen.
pr.sub: Warum wir sind - Unsere Heimat, das Sonnensystem

pr.t: World War II: Secrets From Above
pr.d: Autumn 1942: After devastating Nazi bombing raids, fierce fighting breaks out in the streets of Soviet Stalingrad in the bloodiest battle of WWII.

The summer of 1940 Great Britain stands alone against the Nazis. Now we uncover the wrecks that reveal the real truth on how Britain won the Battle of Britain and kept the allies in the Second World War.
Archaeologists are using advanced technology to uncover the truth behind the Trojan War. Could new discoveries reveal the true events behind this epic tale?
pr.sub: The Mystery of the Trojan War

pr.d: Jo Roger's crew risk defeat when their towing gear shatters in extreme cold. Bjoern's called out to recover a stranded car after two tourists stray onto a ski track, and Thord gets angry when a truck driver ignores his advice.

Shortly after taking off from Shanghai, Korean Air Flight 6316 disappears from radar and slams into a residential neighbourhood. Investigators from China, South Korea, and the US join forces.

pr.t: World War II: Secrets From Above
pr.d: Flying above the infamous battle sites of D-Day and Dunkirk, soaring over hidden Nazi bunkers, and gliding across lost battleships and sunken shipwrecks, exposing secrets of World War Two in a brand-new way.

pr.t: Unmasking the Killers of the Third Reich
pr.d: In 2016, an album containing over 200 previously unpublished photos of Nazi officials was unearthed in the American West. News of this discovery soon reached Dr Stefan Hördler. He immediately knew that he held an exceptional exposé in his hands.

Hitler was against using chemical weapons on the battlefield, but they still play a role in the Nazis' quest for power. Nazis turn pesticide research on its head with tabun and sarin, used in one of the greatest genocides in human history.
Aviation experts determine what went wrong when a Concorde exploded into flames moments after leaving a Paris runway.

Tim, Tommy, and Tia cannot decide on what the best gift could be for their grandmother.

When things go missing in Windsor Gardens, Jonathan believes a black hole is to blame, so Paddington goes on a space mission. Simi and Paddington try to find the gold at the end of the rainbow after they break Baaz's kaleidoscope.
pr.sub: Paddington's Journey Into a Black Hole; Paddington's Rainbow Race!

pr.d: Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!

Peppa and her family are watching television when it suddenly stops working. While Grampy Rabbit attempts to repair it, the family acquires a new, multifunctional TV. However, they soon realise their old set was preferable.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.
It is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George, but they struggle to wait!

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.
Ben is in training for the elf games, and Holly wants to join in but the rules state there is absolutely no flying or magic allowed. Ben gives Holly a chance to join in without using magic.
The children have adopted a new pet, a dragon named Dave. They did not know that he was going to grow and grow though and need to find him a place where he belongs.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.
George is being potty-trained and Mummy Pig is encouraging him to shout "potty" whenever he needs the toilet.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Peppa and George wake up in Granny and Grandpa's motorbike tent by the sea. Peppa finds a message in a bottle with a telephone number on it.
Peppa's Playgroup has a garden outside. The children are all having fun growing different plants and playing hide and seek in the wild wood.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and friends are at school where they have a special guest, Mr Potato. Together they sing the vegetable song about the importance of eating five fruits or vegetables a day. Mr Potato is there to host a special quiz about fruit and vegetables. They argue about a tomato being a vegetable and have to call up a very clever friend to help. Two groups of children compete to find out who knows the most.
pr.sub: Mr. Potato's Fruit and Vegetable Quiz

pr.d: Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
pr.sub: Mr Bull Digs Up the River

pr.d: Peppa and her family take Goldie the Fish to Doctor Hamster for her check-up. They see Grampy Rabbit and his pet newt. Doctor Hamster tells Grampy Rabbit about how she wishes she could exercise more but doesn't have any room. Grampy Rabbit decides to build something special to help Dr Hamster exercise more.
Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig. When the truth is revealed, officers Panda and Squirrel invite them for a ride in their police boat.
During a picnic in her garden, cousin Chloe shows Peppa and George fun things to do with flowers.
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
Madame Gazelle needs to go to the dentist and Bull takes over Peppa's class. As the children already know the suggested themes, Bull decides to show them how to fix a floorboard that is creaking.
Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.
Mummy and Daddy Pig show Peppa and George how to play flying discs in the park. Soon their friends appear with their parents.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised.
Mr Labrador is here in his new ice cream van. It is his first day selling ice creams. In fact, Mr Labrador loves ice cream, perhaps a little too much.

Granny and Grandpa Pig have been growing strawberries to make jam, but the birds have eaten all the fruit. They decide to go and pick their own at Miss Rabbit's strawberry farm, but Granny and Grandpa eat too many strawberries and end up very full.
Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars Play Centre where Miss Rabbit is in charge, and they get to drive little toy cars.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
Rebecca Rabbit has a little brother called Richard who is the same age as George. George and Richard each have a toy dinosaur, but the boys are not very good at sharing their toys.
Peppa loves cycling downhill, but is not so keen on pedalling uphill, so she insists everyone have a downhill race.
Mummy Dog and Danny are very excited. Captain Daddy Dog is home from the sea, and he's bearing gifts. What can they be?
Peppa and Suzy are bored because they have nothing to do, so Daddy Pig finds them an old box of garden games to play with, but not all the games are easy for little George.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Peppa and her family go on a day trip to visit the Windy Castle. Mummy Pig drives, while Daddy Pig reads the map. When they reach the destination, Peppa and George spot Granny and Grandpa Pig's house.
Peppa's family go to the museum's moon exhibition with George's friend, Edmond Elephant.
Miss Rabbit has hurt her ankle, so her sister and her friends offer to fill in for her at the ice cream stand, the supermarket, and everywhere else she works.
Pedro Pony pretends he is a proper cowboy, telling everyone stories in the camp he has set up in the garden.
It's Wendy Wolf's birthday, and she has invited Peppa and all her friends to her party. There are bubbles and balloons to play with, and Wendy even teaches them how to howl like a wolf.
Peppa and her family borrow Grandpa Pig's boat and head out for a day on the river. All is going well until the boat gets stuck in some long reeds. Daddy Pig to the rescue.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Daddy Pig suggests they ride imaginary bikes. Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket, and George sits in the trolley while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list.

It's Peppa Pig's birthday so she awakens very early. First, Peppa gets a present from Mummy, Daddy and George, and then it's time for her party. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks and makes a birthday cake appear with four candles for Peppa to blow out.
Peppa's family gets caught in a very long traffic jam whilst on the way to have lunch with Granny and Grandpa Pig.
Peppa and the rest of the playgroup put on a big Christmas show for all the parents. While Danny Dog is dressed up as a Santa, the real Father Christmas pays them a visit.
Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.
At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical Kiddie Workout.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
Peppa, George, Granny and Grandpa Pig visit the sailing club where they find a juke box. They have fun dancing to all different types of music.
Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding the chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.
Peppa's family embarks on an adventure, but Daddy Pig's fear of heights threatens their climb to the monkey tree.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.

Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check-up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and listens to Mummy tell him all about the changes Peppa has gone through.
Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the 'Super Potato' film.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa's house and have a fun dinosaur party.
Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagines a pirate adventure along the way.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
Peppa and her friends are at their clubhouse. They decide to start a detective club, and when Daddy Pig loses his car keys, they have a real mystery to solve.
While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.
Mummy Pig shows Peppa how to play pretend by teaching her how to wink. Zoe Zebra comes to play with Peppa and brings along her toy monkey. Peppa pretends Monkey has a cough.
Peppa and her family go bowling at the Peppatown Bowling Alley.
Peppa and her friends visit a roller disco organised by Madame Gazelle. After skating along to nursery rhymes, they go wild to the rhythm of the music together with Madame Gazelle.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Peppa and George join Grandma Piggy and her friends to play a game pretending to be Vikings. The Vikings enjoy Grandpa Piggy's boat until they realise they forgot about the picnic.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out for the evening. Granny and Grandpa Pig babysit Peppa and George. They are too excited to sleep. When Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig get home everyone is asleep.
Peppa and Luzie Locke find that adults have to work all the time. The children imitate the elders, in the shop and on the playground. They realise that playing can be really hard work.
Peppa and her friends learn how to count by playing games at Madame Gazelle's playschool.
Madame Gazelle gives the class a music lesson. There's lots of crashing and banging at first, but it's not long before the grown-ups visit and lay down some notes of their own.
George has fun making bubbles, and Peppa has fun popping them.
Suzy Sheep has come to play with Peppa, and has made up a pretend friend called 'Leo Lion'. Peppa can't see Leo, but Suzy announces that Leo likes roaring and playing dressing up.
It's Daddy Pig's birthday, but he has to go to work, so while he's away, Mummy Pig, Peppa and George prepare a special birthday surprise.
Daddy Pig is left behind when everyone takes Grampy Rabbit's little boat to the riverside picnic spot. Will someone remember him and save him some cake?
When Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig are tidying up the house, they happen to find an old box of musical instruments. George makes a loud sound with the Swiss horn.
Peppa and George love helping Mummy Pig work on her computer, but they like playing computer games more.
The youngsters visit the zoo where they are shown around by zookeepers Mr Lion, Mrs Crocodile and Mr Giraffe.
Peppa and George are helping Grandpa Pig to dig a new pond for his garden. While digging, they find hidden treasure so they go to see Mr Richard in the museum.
Dr Hamster's pet tortoise, Tiddles, once again gets stuck on top of a tree, but everyone in the rescue team finds it tough to get the tortoise down.
Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit.
Peppa and George are helping Granny and Grandpa Pig tidy their attic, but they have trouble deciding what to throw out because Granny and Grandpa want to keep everything.

It's a beautiful day but Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig are sitting inside watching the motor racing on the television. Granny Pig shoos them all outside to enjoy the sunshine. Inspired by the racing, Grandpa Pig builds George his own racing car.
Peppa and George visit Granny Pig, who is very excited about her new pet, a parrot called Polly.
Peppa and George have to tidy their bedroom. After a frenzy of cleaning, the room is tidy, but the room doesn't stay tidy for long though.
Daddy Pig hangs his clean football shirt out to dry, but Peppa, George and Mummy splash it with mud. They put it in the wash, but Peppa puts her red dress in too, which turns Daddy's shirt pink.
Doctor Hamster visits the school and brings some animals with her. Binky the Tortoise is very popular, but ends up needing to be rescued by Miss Rabbit.
Peppa and her family collect apples and blackberries in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden to make a pie.
Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.
The grass has grown so long that Peppa and George's ball gets lost in it. It falls to Grandpa to save the day with Betsy, his motorised lawnmower.
George pays a visit to Mr Fox's Shop after his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur, breaks. With all the additional features, surely Dino Roar is a good replacement?
Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try.
PC Panda brings his twin daughters to playgroup Peggy and Pandora Panda. They love puzzles and to solve mysteries just like their dad.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig. Grandpa builds a special hiding hut to watch birds in so they can all go owl-spotting.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. Doctor Hamster shows the children some colourful caterpillars and all the children draw pictures of caterpillars. One caterpillar forms a chrysalis that opens to reveal a pretty butterfly. The children paint butterfly wings and dance the life cycle of a butterfly.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park. Peppa and George play on the hopping logs, the bouncing branch and the monkey bars.
When Daddy Pig is given a parking ticket, Peppa and George learn that adults have rules just like children - and that they get told off too.
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?
Peppa and George are re-enacting the Apollo Moon Landing with the help of Granny Pig's friends. Grampy Rabbit lends them his rocket, but no one has told him it's just pretend.
When George loses the metal wind-up key for his toy robot in the long grass, Grandpa Pig cannot find his metal detector to help George track it down.
Peppa and her friends have fun while painting in the playgroup. Madame Gazelle then teaches them how to play games with parachutes.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
Peppa and George check out Grandpa's new Bug Hotel as lots of insects arrive. A bumblebee cannot find a place in the hotel because the rooms are too small for him.

Madame Gazelle presents the poetry to Peppa and her friends, explaining that sounds can also be poems. When it starts raining, the inspired children create a beautiful poem about the rain and recite it to their parents.
Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.
At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical Kiddie Workout.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
It's fruit day at the market and Miss Rabbit is making smoothies from people's favourite fruit. She gives George a special 'dinosaur' juice to make him big and strong.
Peppa and George have fun in the snow, as they make footprints, snowballs and build a snowman.
Mummy Pig has a lovely new picture of Peppa and George, so Daddy Pig offers to put it up, but it's not as simple as Daddy Pig thought, and he makes a very big hole in the wall.
Goldie the fish does not look happy and is not eating her food. Peppa, George, and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the vet.

Peppa has a new pen pal, a little donkey from France named Delphine. Peppa receives letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they discover that they love lots of the same things, especially jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
Granny Pig is really pleased with all the plastic gnomes and wishing well she's got for the garden. Peppa and George love them too, but Grandpa Pig wishes they would all disappear.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.

Mummy and Daddy Pig let Peppa and George put their coats on over their pyjamas and go outside to look at the stars. With the help of a telescope, Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star.

When a fishing trip goes wrong, leaving Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit stranded on a desert island, Captain Daddy Dog is the only one able to save them. It makes him realise that he misses the sea after all.
Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.

Peppa's best friend, Suzy Sheep, comes to play at Peppa's house for the afternoon. Peppa won't allow George to join in. When Peppa and Suzy want to play doctors and nurses, George is delighted to be the patient.
Granny and Grandpa Pig come for a dinner party with Mummy and Daddy Pig. Peppa and George are too tired to go to bed until they are told a story.
Daddy Pig winds up the old cuckoo clock in Peppa and George's bedroom. When the clock strikes the hour, a wooden bird pops out, flapping its wings and singing 'Cuckoo'.
Daddy teaches the children how to play basketball, and it is not long before they are good enough to take on a much bigger team.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it starts to get foggy, and before long it becomes so foggy that they can't see anything.

The Detective introduces his new friend, the superhero Super Potato, who teaches children the importance of eating fruit and vegetables every day, and later helps the Detective out of a complicated situation.
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.
Everyone in Peppa's town is excited to meet Mr Potato when he comes to open a new sports centre.
Peppa and George want to jump in muddy puddles, but Mummy tells them to go in the pool instead.
Peppa and George take a bin of vegetable peelings to Grandpa Pig's compost heap. Worms inside the bin turn the peelings into compost, which Granny and Grandpa use to help their plants grow.
Madame Gazelle sets the children a creative task of making masks. There are carrot masks, robot masks, and even pretty butterfly masks. The only thing missing is lots and lots of glitter.
Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where they learn how to be real explorers.
Grandpa Pig is planting seeds to make a flower garden, but the birds keep eating them, so Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig to make a scarecrow, which stops the birds eating Grandpa's seeds.
Peppa and family take a trip to the market to buy some apples, cheese and fish. However, they get more than they were expecting when they stop by Mr Fox's stall as he is selling some special items.
Peppa, George, Granny and Grandpa Pig visit the sailing club where they find a juke box. They have fun dancing to all different types of music.
Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding the chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.
Peppa's family embarks on an adventure, but Daddy Pig's fear of heights threatens their climb to the monkey tree.

Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the 'Super Potato' film.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa's house and have a fun dinosaur party.
Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagines a pirate adventure along the way.

Peppa and her friends are at their clubhouse. They decide to start a detective club, and when Daddy Pig loses his car keys, they have a real mystery to solve.
While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.
Mummy Pig shows Peppa how to play pretend by teaching her how to wink. Zoe Zebra comes to play with Peppa and brings along her toy monkey. Peppa pretends Monkey has a cough.
Peppa and her family go bowling at the Peppatown Bowling Alley.
Peppa and her friends visit a roller disco organised by Madame Gazelle. After skating along to nursery rhymes, they go wild to the rhythm of the music together with Madame Gazelle.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Peppa and George join Grandma Piggy and her friends to play a game pretending to be Vikings. The Vikings enjoy Grandpa Piggy's boat until they realise they forgot about the picnic.
Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try.
